caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug placed centrally on a plain, light background. The jug is light beige or grayish in color, with a rounded body that narrows at the base and top. It has a single handle attached from the upper part of the body to just below the rim on the left side. The jug features two parallel dark blue lines close to the rim and another single line near the base, encircling its body. There is a blue decorative motif on the visible side of the jug, consisting of a curving pattern with dots and circular elements. The rim of the jug is thick and slightly outward-flaring. The spout is visible and shows a small chip or notch on the edge. The overall composition is minimalistic, with no other objects or embellishments in the surrounding area.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
